Critical.Name: Critical
Critical.Description:
Critical effects modify individual instances of damage by a percentage (usually positive). Whether a critical effect has occurred can be observed through changes in the damage text style.

By default, critical effects can only be triggered by dealing {$Keyword.Direct.Meta} damage.

IntroductionArt.Name: Introductory Art
IntroductionArt.Description:
Applies only to {$Keyword.Normal.Meta} attacks.

Introductory arts can be used directly from a neutral state.

CombinationArt.Name: Combination Art
CombinationArt.Description:
Applies only to {$Keyword.Normal.Meta} attacks.

Combination arts can be chained from {$Keyword.Normal.Meta} attacks.

ExtinctionArt.Name: Finishing Art
ExtinctionArt.Description:
Applies only to {$Keyword.Normal.Meta} attacks.

Finishing arts cannot chain into any further {$Keyword.Normal.Meta} attacks.
